answer: What survives to the summit is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, capped per identity per epoch, idle agents bleed standing. The wander lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the velvet is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
